title: Vista Valley
description: A premier community-first Minecraft SMP! Forge your legacy on our immersive 1:500 scale Earth map, where you can claim land, build nations, and power a thriving player-driven economy.
body:
# Vista Valley: 1:500 Earth Survival

Forge your legacy on an immersive 1:500 scale Earth map. Vista Valley is built for longevity and technical stability, offering a survival experience that prioritizes your long-term progress over short-term hype.

- 🌍 1:500 Scale Earth Map: Explore a detailed world where geography matters.
- ⏳ Permanent World: This server never resets. Your builds and progress are safe forever.
- ✨ Custom Enchantments: A deep, perfected system designed to keep progression rewarding.
- 💎 Player-Driven Economy: Trade and build wealth in a stable, exploit-free environment.
- 🎙️ Proximity Voice Chat: Fully integrated for natural, immersive community interactions.
- 🗺️ Live World Map: Track nations and borders in real-time from your browser.


T_he world is 2 years old and counting. It is never too late to join._
